news.title: Nanbeige Releases Nanbeige4.3-33B, a 33B Open Agentic Coding Model
news.summary: Nanbeige LLM Lab released Nanbeige4.3-33B, a 33B dense Apache 2.0 model with 512K context. It reports 80.9 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and will teach the upcoming Nanbeige4.3-3B. The post Nanbeige Releases Nanbeige4.3-33B, a 33B Open Agentic Coding Model appeared first on MarkTechPost.

news.title: Hugging Face Releases Carbon-X, a 14B Open DNA Language Model that Brings DNA and Natural Language Together for the First Time
news.summary: Hugging Face released Carbon-X, an open 14.8B DNA language model built on Qwen3-14B. It reads raw DNA in chat, answers in English, and averages 66.7% across 5 DNA benchmarks under Apache 2.0. The post Hugging Face Releases Carbon-X, a 14B Open DNA Language Model that Brings DNA and Natural Language Together for the First Time appeared first on MarkTechPost.

news.title: Researchers from Stanford and UC Berkeley Introduce TokenGate: Token-Gated Attention Makes Long-Context Prefill Up to 11.3x Faster
news.summary: Stanford and UC Berkeley researchers released TokenGate, a drop-in learned token pruning module for LLMs. It cuts long-context prefill time-to-first-token by 1.4x to 11.3x and peak memory by 1.5x to 3.4x without accuracy loss. The post Researchers from Stanford and UC Berkeley Introduce TokenGate: Token-Gated Attention Makes Long-Context Prefill Up to 11.3x Faster appeared first on MarkTechPost.

news.title: Microsoft Open-Sources Agensh: A Multi-Agent Harness for 1,024 Agents
news.summary: Microsoft Research open-sourced Agensh, a multi-agent harness with no central orchestrator. Self-organizing workers share a Git repo, chat and a findings board, scaling from 1 to 1,024 agents on ProgramBench under a 6-hour budget.
